research_question: In people with established cardiovascular disease (secondary prevention), do interleukin-1 receptor antagonists / IL-1 pathway blockers (anakinra, canakinumab) reduce all-cause mortality compared with placebo or usual care?
outcome_description: All-cause mortality (death from any cause) during trial follow-up, reported as number of deaths per randomised group (or as an effect estimate such as RR/OR/HR with variance).
positive_direction: A positive effect size means IL-1 blockade reduced all-cause mortality relative to placebo/usual care (fewer deaths in the treatment arm).
search_queries: anakinra cardiovascular randomized controlled trial mortality
canakinumab atherosclerosis myocardial infarction trial outcomes
interleukin-1 blockade anti-inflammatory therapy coronary artery disease clinical trial
inclusion_criteria: Studies in adults with established cardiovascular disease (e.g. prior myocardial infarction, acute coronary syndrome, stable coronary artery disease, heart failure, stroke) or at high cardiovascular risk
Evaluates an interleukin-1 receptor antagonist or IL-1 pathway blocker (anakinra, canakinumab, or similar IL-1 inhibitor) against placebo, usual care, or no added anti-inflammatory therapy
Reports any quantitative clinical outcome data, including death counts or any mortality/event estimate, at any follow-up duration
exclusion_criteria: Not an original empirical study (systematic review, meta-analysis, narrative review, editorial, commentary, opinion piece, guideline, or purely theoretical/modelling paper)
No comparison between an IL-1 blockade treatment condition and a placebo/usual-care control condition (e.g. single-arm or uncontrolled case series)
No extractable quantitative outcome data permitting an effect size (no event counts, means+SDs, t/F statistics, proportions, or ratio estimates with variance)
Completely unrelated to IL-1 blockade in cardiovascular disease (e.g. purely rheumatologic, oncologic, or preclinical animal/in vitro studies with no clinical cardiovascular outcomes)
moderators_to_extract: Drug sub-type (anakinra vs canakinumab vs other IL-1 inhibitor)
Baseline cardiovascular population (post-MI/ACS vs stable CAD vs heart failure)
Risk of bias / blinding and comparator type (placebo vs usual care)
effect_size_note: Pool as risk ratios (RR) with 95% CIs using event counts per arm; drug sub-type (anakinra vs canakinumab) analysed as separate subgroups within one pooled random-effects model, with a test for subgroup differences.
